## SECURITY REQUIREMENTS (CLIENT SIDE)

* Use ONLY backend-provided permissions
* Do NOT define or hardcode privileges
* Hide/disable UI based on permissions
* Always assume backend is final authority
* Permissions must be dynamically retrieved (e.g. from user session/API)
* Subdomain routing rules (MANDATORY):
  - Login UI runs on `{AUTH_SUBDOMAIN}.{BASE_DOMAIN}` (default: `auth`)
  - After login, redirect/switch host:
    - If tenant has handle: `{tenantHandle}.{BASE_DOMAIN}`
    - Else: `{APP_SUBDOMAIN}.{BASE_DOMAIN}` (default: `app`)
  - Local dev must support `*.lvh.me`

### 3. TESTING

* Playwright E2E tests for this feature (MANDATORY)

    - Run at least one test against `http://tenant2.lvh.me:<port>` (same port)
    - Prove tenant isolation (data/visibility differs across tenants where applicable)
  - Cross-subdomain auth/session correctness (MANDATORY):
    - Start on `http://auth.lvh.me:<port>` (default **3000**), log in, and verify host switches to tenant/app as specified by architecture
    - If cookie-based auth is used:
      - Assert cookie domain/attributes are compatible with subdomains (e.g. domain `.lvh.me`, HttpOnly, SameSite/Secure strategy)
      - Assert an authenticated request works after switching from `auth.*` to `{tenant|app}.*` without re-login
      - Assert CSRF works (token acquisition + submission + server acceptance) for a state-changing request
  - Prefer accessible selectors (getByRole) or `data-testid` (avoid brittle CSS selectors)
